scope: Keep archived dashboard query SQL in PostgreSQL while omitting it from current Directus API responses.

behavior.read: Items and pages omit query_sql without mutating source objects
behavior.create_update: Presence of query_sql is rejected with INVALID_PAYLOAD / HTTP 400
behavior.storage: Existing archived database values are preserved

remaining_gates: Effective deployed Directus field and role permissions for all fields
Populated dashboard parity and external consumer authorization
